newsitem.title: UK: LME base metals barely changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME base metals barely changed in late trade.

text.p: Base metal prices barely budged from their afternoon closing levels in late trade on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
Three month copper futures were last quoted at $2,123/26 a tonne by 1835 GMT from $2,127 at the afternoon kerb close.
Traders were looking ahead to Tuesday's LME stock data for further signs of rising stocks and easing supplies.

Of particular interest is the Singapore stockpile. Another sizeable increase would suggest China needed less copper than originally thought, and was therefore delivering metal back on to the exchange to profit from backwardations, traders said.
Nickel was last quoted at $6,480/540, slightly up from the afternoon close of $6,476, a fresh 2-1/4 year low.
Dealers said weak fundamentals and bearish chart patterns pointed to further losses for nickel, although a corrective bounce might be needed first.
Other metals were also little changed from afternoon levels.
